data.long_meaning: In Arabic, Kamayel means 'Lord of the sky' or 'God of the clouds'. It is a name of Allah in Islamic tradition. The name Kamayel carries the meaning “Lord of the sky” and is chosen by families in Islamic traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Arabic tradition and is also used in Arabic, Urdu, Persian. Parents who choose Kamayel usually hope their child will grow to embody lord of the sky and live with faith, good character and purpose.
